ecosim-2dea74d9.description: EcoSIM at upstream commit 2dea74d9 — first non-FATES adapter-kit dogfood (BioCON test1_ex1)
ecosim-2dea74d9.param_files_extra_note: REFERENCE surfaces for documentation only -- no run reads these. Runs resolve A2MC_BASE_PARAM_FILE / _SECONDARY_ / _3 from the SITE CONFIG, which points at the m5199 project space. DELIBERATE DISCREPANCY: the microbial file indexed here is the 77-variable SPOSC-bearing copy, whereas EcoSIM_BioCON R3's production base (R3_28Para_Sobol_base/MicrobePars_SB1_b1.nc) has 76 variables with SPOSC ABSENT. The 77-var copy is indexed so SPOSC is documented and reachable in the graph; it is NOT evidence that R3 could vary SPOSC -- R3 demonstrably could not, which is a separate finding. See use_cases/EcoSIM_BioCON/memory/gained_knowledge/discoveries.json -> sposc_is_a_large_live_lever_and_the_r3_probe_was_unattributable.
ecosim-2dea74d9.notes: First adapter-kit non-FATES milestone. Uses the generic `adapter`/`model_commit_built`/`model_wiki_subdir` keys (not the FATES-specific fates_*/elm_* schema); version-association dispatches on `adapter`. expected_counts are null placeholders — filled from the first RAG build (T5) to arm the count-regression guard. Authoritative dataset paths live in models/ecosim/datasets.py (ModelDataset ecosim-2dea74d9); curated_yaml is the v0.1 ai-draft seed pending PI review.

pflotran-157a26f7.description: PFLOTRAN at upstream commit 157a26f7 — the commit Jianwen Du's miniLEO build was compiled from
pflotran-157a26f7.notes: Second adapter-kit non-FATES milestone; uses the generic adapter/model_commit_built/model_wiki_subdir schema. Wiki is VALIDATED GREEN (2392/2392 citations, 123/123 routines; docs/a2mc_reference/wiki_source_validation_pflotran_157a26f7.md). param_file/output_cdl are NULL BY NATURE, not pending: PFLOTRAN's parameter surface is a text card deck and its outputs are fixed-width text + Tecplot, and both are PER-CASE files living outside this repo (the miniLEO bundle is 99 MB and belongs to the team's own repository). The build reads them via A2MC_PFLOTRAN_DECK / A2MC_PFLOTRAN_REFERENCE_MAS when present, and degrades to a curated-only graph when absent. curated_yaml_path now points at the v0.2 seed (2026-08-01): source-verified, adversarially re-verified by a 4-agent fan-out whose 13 hard errors are fixed, 231 resolving citations. NOT YET PI-REVIEWED -- promote curated_yaml_status to 'human' only after that review. Pinned to the team's build commit, NOT upstream master, which is 523 commits / a major version ahead (dev log 20260731c).
